7.9.5.5.1 DTR visibility
This chapter describes a run-time (re-)configuration method for variant handling to set
DTRs to invisible without removing them from the configuration.
It is recommended to set DTRs to invisible in the ECU startup phase before diagnostic
requests are processed.
Interleaving of any run-time reconfiguration and diagnostic request processing may
lead to temporary "inconsistencies" in diagnostic protocols.
The non-volatile storage of the visibility state of a DTR is a concept to minimize this
issue.
The Dem support the visibility of DTRs.
DTRs which are invisible are treated as if not configured.
[SWS_Dem_01410]
Upstream requirements: RS_Diag_04274
⌈The visibility state shall be set by calling the interface Dem_SetDTR. If Dem_SetDTR is
called with Dem_DTRControlType set to DEM_DTR_CTL_INVISIBLE the DTR state
is set to "invisible". If Dem_SetDTR is called with any other defined Dem_DTRCon-
trolType (DEM_DTR_CTL_NORMAL, DEM_DTR_CTL_NO_MAX, DEM_DTR_CTL_NO_-
MIN, DEM_DTR_CTL_RESET) the DTR state is set to "visible".⌋
[SWS_Dem_01411]
Upstream requirements: RS_Diag_04274
⌈The visibility state of DTRs shall be stored non-volatile. The initial visibility state of
DTRs shall be "visible".⌋
